metadata.recordScope: Fabric and leather records and attributes as listed in the April 2026 program. They do not establish current availability or model eligibility.

N.name: Normal
N.description: Recommended for use on all La-Z-Boy upholstered furniture.

P.name: Performance
P.description: Excellent ratings for durability, abrasion, pilling and fraying.

Medium.name: Medium Duty
Medium.description: Allowed on sofas, sleep sofas, duo products, classics and occasional chairs only.

leatherTypes.Authentic: Pure, transparent dyes show the natural markings in each hide: wrinkles, scars and brands. Every Authentic leather has a protective topcoat.
leatherTypes.Performance: Consistent color and subtle markings, made with embossing, corrective techniques and protective coatings that resist soil.
leatherTypes.Nubuck: Infused with transparent dyes for subtle color variation without hiding the natural character of the hide.

leatherGroups.Select Leather Reclining: Married leather with a urethane or vinyl match on specific reclining frames.
leatherGroups.Select Leather Stationary: Married leather with a urethane or vinyl match on specific stationary frames.
leatherGroups.Custom Leather Match: Custom leather with a urethane match on select frames.
leatherGroups.Custom Leather Plus: Custom leather available on most frames.
leatherGroups.Specialty Leather: Custom leather on most frames. Swatch sets must be requested and purchased.

notes: The source gives this model as 805 Ace in one column and 805 Ignace in another.
